# Creation Phase Template

Complete one approved usable increment before building and operating its production entrypoint. Task completion records implementation progress; it never opens a per-task verifier or test gate.

## Execution contract

Select the approved scope from the canonical KBD/OpenSpec ledger and assign disjoint ownership through the selected team. Record the delivery profile/root, named outcome, source baselines, full featureOperation contract, owners and resource roots in the authored dispatch artifact. Preserve the current goal controller. Use the portable Node Cadence path when this profile is selected; do not invoke legacy shell launchers.

A featureOperation names the actual production command and expected observed behavior, or an approved task to create that procedure. Preserve target/evidence limits and permitted effects. If a change split moves the original operation to a later phase, assign a bounded replacement explicitly before starting. A recording-fake suite is not real-service evidence.

## Production and delivery flow

1. Implement all selected production behavior, UI, strings, persistence and packaging. Record canonical task progress through kbd-apply. No per-task verifier, unit suite or verification build.
2. Resolve child architecture through its existing approval stages. Attach it to the parent delivery clock; unresolved work remains blocking. Three failures alone do not authorize a new architecture or scope.
3. Mark ready and freeze the complete candidate. Build that frozen checkout, launch the artifact and operate the newly delivered function. Preserve exact source/artifact evidence and truthful failed attempts.
4. While that candidate builds or publishes, optionally admit one approved independent work-ahead scope in isolated roots. Keep a single active KBD phase/iteration. Do not mutate a build-owned checkout or consume its output directory.
5. Fix demonstrated failures in a batch, repeat only the failed operation, and reconcile the repaired base before promotion. Independent authorized edits may continue; dependent promotion waits.
6. Finish using canonical completion references. Respect actual review/child/hook gates. Record publication through candidate-specific obligations, platform receipts and website updates, separately from installed acceptance.
7. Promote eligible work-ahead preserving its original firstWorkAt, or return the resumable status when a budget, approval or harness limit stops execution.

## Evidence and stopping

Build result, launch, feature operation, publication and installed acceptance are separate facts. Capture operation logs and immutable receipts under the configured Cadence root. A window opening proves launch only; a dispatched workflow proves dispatch only. Existing receipts may be adopted only through the matching source/command/artifact contract.

Goal completion requires its actual stopping conditions and canonical lifecycle closeout. Unresolved children, required approvals or missing evidence are reported, never converted to success. Use the current harness's available continuation capability; no second daemon or invented native command.
